title: Places Ive been recently
content: I've been stuck at the desert festival for a while now. It's very dry, dusty, and everyone is always trying to get water. I live in either a tent, or a beat down school bus. Then there's the crowds, and the lines to get to the stage which is insanely packed. It feels like burning man or something idk. If I'm not in the desert: I'm in my upside down neighborhood it's basically my apartment building and my street, but in dream world. Last night we were attacked by something/someone who lit the building on fire, and then blew it up. I had to evacuate myself and my cat and we watched our building crumble from the other side of the street. After that I was forced to live in the mall it was the only other place that hadn't been burned down or bombed. So I brought my cat and we walk around the mall together, we went to the movie theater, to restaurants, and then we got a hotel room. I remember telling the lady who checked us in that our apartment was bombed and she said yes many people are coming here. Then I rode the elevators at the hotel for a while because they are so tricky. They take you to different buildings in the mall, and different stores, and I was trying to get back to my room and it was basically impossible because the elevators just decide where you go. So yeah the cat and I were wandering last night.
